requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-1486-4231-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1115-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1115-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

483-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1436-4644-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-4644-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

3899-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

883-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

486-1978-7935.description:
Cause Gumato to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Gumato by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gumato.
Repeat from step 2.

533-5425-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You have no cards in hand.
533-5425-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Anthem of Rakdos.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2060-2700-2744-4499-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-2700-2744-4499-7803.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1978-4241-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Karn.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

193-2724-4006-4450.description:
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Hushbringer.
Repeat each turn.

240-643-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-2511.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3169-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Spirit en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7159.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1308-4682-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4682-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

719-2034-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2034-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

969-1682-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-1682-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1562-4375-5330.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

826-1238-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3240-6462-6560.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

803-997-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-997-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

64-372-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

141-5132-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one legendary planeswalker or creature.
141-5132-5256.description:
Cast Primevals' Glorious Rebirth by paying {5}{W}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Primevals' Glorious Rebirth.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing target player to mill cards equal to Naru Meha's power.
Resolve the copy of Primevals' Glorious Rebirth, returning all legendary permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

24-1981-4591.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number, and dealing that much damage to you if you chose the largest number.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the amount of damage dealt this way.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

765-1479-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-3703.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2907-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1678-3284-3944-5220.description:
Sacrifice Blood Pet to add {B}.
Put it on top of your library with Mortuary and proceed to draw it with Korvold.
Ping with Mayhem Devil.
With your floating mana, recast Blood Pet.

614-1964-1987-2427.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
